name: Freies Radio
blurb: Freies Radio – The platform for community radios.
description:
Freies Radio – The platform for community radios.

Discover the diversity of community radios. Live streams, podcasts and on-demand shows – all in one app.

FEATURES

🎙️ Live stream
Listen to community radios live – even in the background.

📅 Program guide
See what's playing now and what's coming up. Never miss a show.

📻 Listen to past shows
Missed something? No problem. Listen to past programs from the archive.

🎧 Podcasts
Discover podcasts from community radios.

📍 Location-based selection
The app automatically shows you stations in your area.

ABOUT COMMUNITY RADIOS

Community radios (Freie Radios) are non-commercial, independent radio stations. They offer an alternative to public broadcasting and private stations – with content from people in the region, for people in the region.
